input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The separator selection negates any_prefix_is_slash, picking ' / ' exactly when an option spelling already starts with a slash and '; ' otherwise.
- failure path: An option declared as --shout/--no-shout renders in --help as '--shout; --no-shout', and a Windows-style /debug;/no-debug option renders as '/debug / /no-debug', where the slash separator is indistinguishable from the slash prefix of the names.

Reviewer finding
- description: The separator condition was inverted during refactoring. The original code was `"; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`, but the new code is `"; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`.
- rationale: Trigger: any option with secondary opts, such as `--flag/--no-flag`. The new code joins them with "; " instead of " / ", and options using a slash prefix get " / " instead of "; ". Help output changes for every boolean flag with secondary options, and the snapshot is wrong.
critique: The finding names the same negated condition on any_prefix_is_slash in the separator selection. It describes the same swapped outcomes: --flag/--no-flag gets '; ', and slash-prefixed options get ' / '.
